diff --git a/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py b/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py
index 0833435..6ba26ae 100644
--- a/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py
+++ b/openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py
@@ -5,6 +5,66 @@ from unicodedata import normalize
 import openlibrary.catalog.merge.normalize as merge
 
 
+re_amazon_title_paren = re.compile(r'^(.*) \([^)]+?\)$')
+
+
+def build_titles(title: str) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Create normalized and alternative titles for an edition's full title."""
+    normalized_title = merge.normalize(title).lower()
+    titles = [title, normalized_title]
+    if ' & ' in title:
+        alternative = title.replace(' & ', ' and ')
+        titles.extend((alternative, merge.normalize(alternative)))
+
+    without_articles = []
+    for variant in titles:
+        if variant.lower().startswith('the '):
+            without_articles.append(variant[4:])
+        elif variant.lower().startswith('a '):
+            without_articles.append(variant[2:])
+    titles += without_articles
+
+    if re_amazon_title_paren.match(title):
+        without_parentheses = []
+        for variant in titles:
+            match = re_amazon_title_paren.match(variant)
+            if match:
+                without_parentheses.extend(
+                    (match.group(1), merge.normalize(match.group(1)))
+                )
+        titles += without_parentheses
+
+    return {
+        'full_title': title,
+        'normalized_title': normalized_title,
+        'titles': titles,
+        'short_title': normalized_title[:25],
+    }
+
+
+def expand_record(rec: dict) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Expand an edition record into title and ISBN variants for comparison."""
+    expanded = build_titles(rec['full_title'])
+    isbns = []
+    for field in ('isbn', 'isbn_10', 'isbn_13'):
+        isbns.extend(rec.get(field, []))
+    expanded['isbn'] = isbns
+
+    if 'publish_country' in rec and rec['publish_country'] not in ('   ', '|||'):
+        expanded['publish_country'] = rec['publish_country']
+    for field in (
+        'lccn',
+        'publishers',
+        'publish_date',
+        'number_of_pages',
+        'authors',
+        'contribs',
+    ):
+        if field in rec:
+            expanded[field] = rec[field]
+    return expanded
+
+
 def cmp(x, y):
     return (x > y) - (x < y)

@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+from openlibrary.catalog.utils import expand_record
+
+
+def test_expand_record_comparison_fields():
+    rec = {
+        'full_title': 'A test full title : subtitle (parens).',
+        'isbn': ['1111111111'],
+        'isbn_10': ['2222222222'],
+        'isbn_13': ['3333333333333'],
+        'lccn': ['12345678'],
+        'publishers': ['Example Press'],
+        'publish_date': '2000',
+        'number_of_pages': 120,
+        'authors': [{'name': 'An Author'}],
+        'contribs': [{'name': 'A Contributor'}],
+        'publish_country': 'xxu',
+        'source_records': ['ia:example'],
+    }
+
+    result = expand_record(rec)
+
+    assert result['full_title'] == rec['full_title']
+    assert result['normalized_title'] == 'a test full title subtitle (parens)'
+    assert result['short_title'] == 'a test full title subtitl'
+    assert 'A test full title : subtitle (parens).' in result['titles']
+    assert 'a test full title subtitle (parens)' in result['titles']
+    assert result['isbn'] == ['1111111111', '2222222222', '3333333333333']
+    for field in (
+        'lccn',
+        'publishers',
+        'publish_date',
+        'number_of_pages',
+        'authors',
+        'contribs',
+        'publish_country',
+    ):
+        assert result[field] == rec[field]
+    assert 'source_records' not in result
+    assert rec['isbn'] == ['1111111111']
+
+
+def test_expand_record_filters_empty_publish_country():
+    for country in ('   ', '|||'):
+        assert 'publish_country' not in expand_record(
+            {'full_title': 'The Book', 'publish_country': country}
+        )

 import openlibrary.catalog.merge.normalize as merge
 
 
+re_amazon_title_paren = re.compile(r'^(.*) \([^)]+?\)$')
+
+
+def build_titles(title: str) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Create normalized and alternative titles for an edition's full title."""
+    normalized_title = merge.normalize(title).lower()
+    titles = [title, normalized_title]
+    if ' & ' in title:
+        alternative = title.replace(' & ', ' and ')
+        titles.extend((alternative, merge.normalize(alternative)))
+
+    without_articles = []
+    for variant in titles:
+        if variant.lower().startswith('the '):
+            without_articles.append(variant[4:])
+        elif variant.lower().startswith('a '):
+            without_articles.append(variant[2:])
+    titles += without_articles
+
+    if re_amazon_title_paren.match(title):
+        without_parentheses = []
+        for variant in titles:
+            match = re_amazon_title_paren.match(variant)
+            if match:
+                without_parentheses.extend(
+                    (match.group(1), merge.normalize(match.group(1)))
+                )
+        titles += without_parentheses
+
+    return {
+        'full_title': title,
+        'normalized_title': normalized_title,
+        'titles': titles,
+        'short_title': normalized_title[:25],
+    }
+
+
+def expand_record(rec: dict) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Expand an edition record into title and ISBN variants for comparison."""
+    expanded = build_titles(rec['full_title'])
+    isbns = []
+    for field in ('isbn', 'isbn_10', 'isbn_13'):
+        isbns.extend(rec.get(field, []))
+    expanded['isbn'] = isbns
+
+    if 'publish_country' in rec and rec['publish_country'] not in ('   ', '|||'):
+        expanded['publish_country'] = rec['publish_country']
+    for field in (
+        'lccn',
+        'publishers',
+        'publish_date',
+        'number_of_pages',
+        'authors',
+        'contribs',
+    ):
+        if field in rec:
+            expanded[field] = rec[field]
+    return expanded

+from openlibrary.catalog.utils import expand_record
+
+
+def test_expand_record_comparison_fields():
+    rec = {
+        'full_title': 'A test full title : subtitle (parens).',
+        'isbn': ['1111111111'],
+        'isbn_10': ['2222222222'],
+        'isbn_13': ['3333333333333'],
+        'lccn': ['12345678'],
+        'publishers': ['Example Press'],
+        'publish_date': '2000',
+        'number_of_pages': 120,
+        'authors': [{'name': 'An Author'}],
+        'contribs': [{'name': 'A Contributor'}],
+        'publish_country': 'xxu',
+        'source_records': ['ia:example'],
+    }
+
+    result = expand_record(rec)
+
+    assert result['full_title'] == rec['full_title']
+    assert result['normalized_title'] == 'a test full title subtitle (parens)'
+    assert result['short_title'] == 'a test full title subtitl'
+    assert 'A test full title : subtitle (parens).' in result['titles']
+    assert 'a test full title subtitle (parens)' in result['titles']
+    assert result['isbn'] == ['1111111111', '2222222222', '3333333333333']
+    for field in (
+        'lccn',
+        'publishers',
+        'publish_date',
+        'number_of_pages',
+        'authors',
+        'contribs',
+        'publish_country',
+    ):
+        assert result[field] == rec[field]
+    assert 'source_records' not in result
+    assert rec['isbn'] == ['1111111111']
+
+
+def test_expand_record_filters_empty_publish_country():
+    for country in ('   ', '|||'):
+        assert 'publish_country' not in expand_record(
+            {'full_title': 'The Book', 'publish_country': country}
+        )
